title: Up Freeman Canyon
text: By 1870, a good wagon road ran the entire distance from Gilroy to Cerro Gordo for travelers using the Walker Pass route. Today Highway 178 serves automobile traffic over the pass, up Freeman Canyon. In the 1870s and 1880s, a hideout of the outlaw Tiburcio Vásquez and Cleovaro Chavez was near the trail at the foot of the pass, on the desert side.
